title: Validate Southern South America batch 3 provenance and comparison bindings

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Reviewed scope and dependencies ready for a worker claim

labels.name: type:geography
labels.description: Geographic source research, hierarchy/boundary evidence and proposals; no live mutations

body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

PR #940, merge `e971ae4bdc6b4fa4abb316f541c1cabf16c43625`, retains a 230-subject research packet under `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/`. Two verified evidence-control defects prevent relying on its source restoration and record binding.

1. `source-inventory.json` and `RESEARCH.md` claim original raw-source hashes at geoBoundaries commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d` that disagree with authenticated GitHub LFS pointers. ARG ADM2 is 69,702,323 bytes: packet `cedee8710e49d9017327fc1d4b2dc536e95a82317dc94c3bac8d9404af6bf771`, upstream `f35dae5a257302dea5bd1549ae135baf82e7ee7491918854c3db9bbdec890177`. CHL ADM3 is 171,783,952 bytes: packet `f6852723bc6d44d4813086fe9df750e7228e1925a72284e3d2b65ed44e2aa99a`, upstream `f3833ce1965394ae705e3793b50bdd007775b43da604251871deffed04f3bffd`. Whole upstream objects were not downloaded; GitHub pointers establish the immutable object's raw SHA-256 and size. A correct raw download would fail the packet's prescribed digest check. Do not silently assume a conversion or substitute current upstream data.

2. `check-packet.py` verifies comparison roster/flags and file hashes but does not bind per-row baseline fields to the actual pinned Atlas features. In an isolated read-interception control, changing only `geometry-comparisons.jsonl` row `gb:ARG:ADM2:61730980B10000603471831` from actual parent `framework:province:rio-negro:1609a338a963` to `country-SPI`, then updating that file's inventory byte count/hash consistently, still makes the original checker pass its 230-subject/29-parent/disposition checks. Every retained original stayed unchanged. Independent verification of the committed rows finds their actual names, source IDs, parents, baseline geometry types/validity/component counts correct; this is a validator false positive, not proof that the committed record has that fabricated parent.

Reproduce with authenticated `gh api` contents for the two exact country/layer paths at the immutable commit and decode their LFS pointers. For the checker control, intercept the single comparison file and inventory reads in an isolated detached baseline, update only the one comparison parent and its descriptor, and run the inspected original checker. It currently accepts; a new independent validator must reject that mismatch. Do not mutate the original packet as a test.

Scope: exactly 53 ARG ADM2 and 177 CHL ADM3 subjects from #444, all named in the machine declaration. New owned evidence only. #937 owns its 16 Argentina semantic/source candidates, #938 owns its 98 Chile candidates; their existing research scope is unchanged. This task adds shared packet provenance and validation, without making competing geographic corrections. Similar #1111/#1116 cover different packets, scripts and rosters; full open/closed issue discovery found no existing task for these affected files.

Acceptance:
- Preserve every original source/claim/result/script and stable ID. Add a new vintage that records both original asserted and actual authenticated raw-source OIDs/sizes, exact upstream paths/commit and limitations; distinguish raw bytes from any transformed representation with separately supported hashes. Bind restoration instructions to the actual source vintage.
- Independently reconcile every comparison and assessment baseline identity/name/parent/source/type/component field against actual pinned GeoJSON, reject duplicates/foreign subjects/mismatched fields, and reconcile match counts/unmatched IDs, geometry flags, disposition and parent summaries. Do not merely compare self-reported totals or recomputed hashes.
- Exercise meaningful negative controls for the demonstrated false parent, wrong source identity/type, wrong pointer vintage, duplicate/foreign subject and inconsistent summary; positive controls must retain the original exact scope. Reproduce new derived outputs twice and bind controls/results, all changed files and numerical metrics in evidence_quality v1.
- Separate observed retained results from independently source-verified measurements. Original IGN/Subdere geometry captures, Law 1186 text, change log, name-variant facts and source rights remain unavailable/unverified here. The assessment generator reproduces from retained measurements but cannot certify their source-derived IoUs. Keep that missing verification explicit.
- Do not restore oversized originals/archives or widen evidence limits. Source restoration or geometry remeasurement requires lawful bounded partitioning in separately reviewed work; do not replace missing originals with invented fixtures or approve geography. No core edits, production writes, imports or deployment.
- Obtain substantive distinct exact-head review. One PR; parent #444 is closed/released. This ready validation/provenance task can use the complete retained baseline and authenticated LFS pointers without the missing full geometry captures.

Named pins below map to these complete actual baseline files; use baseline.pin_files in the new manifest:
- `baseline-hierarchy` → `data/hierarchy.json`.
- `baseline-world-index` → `data/world-index.json`.
- `baseline-part-0` → `data/geography/part-0.json`.
- `baseline-part-2` → `data/geography/part-2.json`.
- `original-scope` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/scope.json`.
- `original-inventory` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/source-inventory.json`.
- `original-comparisons` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/geometry-comparisons.jsonl`.
- `original-assessments` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/location-assessments.jsonl`.
- `original-summary` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/geometry-summary.json`.
- `original-checker` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e9f1d51da6b0a22/check-packet.py`.
